name: plan-fixture-images
goal: Fixture image generators give a Plan with the default three options distinct valid pictures; one single-design case asks for one; production unchanged.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Root runtime red on ecdbf507 via failed-event observer: project-kind and remote-ownership runs fail with 'Design options repeat an image'; fake generators repeat one PNG.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Frozen guard 67061b: old Ecdb fixtures fail remote, local and native Plan paths. Root log f03264c preserves all three failures.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fixture-only: remote-fixture distinct 2x2 PNGs, first byte-exact; fixture script variant pictures, first exact; one single-design case asks designOptions 1. Production unchanged.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same guard passes three cases; original six families pass 31 tests, duplicate control and mapping pass. Original assertions and deadlines unchanged.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
